notes:
T635 (mechanized model assignment, ruling 33). BUILT — `managent assign <id>`: filters the canonical model list (`managent models`, T317's single source) through the constraints that apply and records the draw on the row. Qualified-candidate filter = family appetite (measurement-methodology.md §1: OFF/RESERVED/PROBE families are excluded with a reason), plus row-declared exclusions (bundle `exclude=` key or `--exclude` flag; each token a family name or canonical model). The draw uses OS entropy (`std.Io.randomSecure` via an OsEntropy wrapper — no seeded PRNG, no clock/task-derived seed; EntropyUnavailable panics rather than falling back). Recorded on the row: `candidates` (qualified list drawn from), `method` (random | forced | preferred), `assign_reasons` (one "<model>: <why>" per excluded candidate), and the outcome in `model` with `model_source="assign:<method>"` so assignment provenance is not mistaken for first-hand attribution (T544). `method` is queryable via `status --json` and `show`, so downstream can partition method=random (unconfounded) from observational rows. `--model <name>` forces `preferred`; a one-element qualified list forces `forced`; otherwise `random`. `--dry-run` computes without writing; `--json` emits the result object on stdout.

CONTROLS (all seeded, all green — `zig test src/managent/main.zig`, 8/8; wired into `zig build test` via the pre-existing managent_tests addTest step): (1) 3 candidates drawn 3000× → counts 945/980/1075, all within ±15% of 1000; (2) constraints eliminating all but one → method=forced, candidates list of one; (3) naming an explicit model → method=preferred, qualified list still recorded; (4) a row with no assignment record parses unchanged (method null, empty lists); (5) appetite OFF (ollama-cloud) absent from every candidate list with the reason recorded. End-to-end smoke against a scratch MANAGENT_STORE (never the live kanban): assign --dry-run --json, assign --json, --model, --exclude, and a bundle-declared `exclude=claude` all produce the expected method/model/candidates/reasons, and show/status--json expose them.

VERIFICATION — build green (`zig build`); per-module `zig test src/managent/main.zig` 8/8. The implementation was already present in the working tree when this seat (T635.2) claimed the row (T635.1 built it); the invariants are asserted directly rather than re-deriving a red state, which would require reverting a completed implementation.

DESIGN DECISIONS / LIMITS: (a) harness-fits-scope is not a separate mechanized check — it is expressed through row-declared exclusions (e.g. `exclude=claude` for the 5h-window, family independence, or authorship conflict), which is the brief's 'explicit exclusion the row declares' mechanism; (b) the outcome reuses `model` (with assign: provenance) rather than a new field, so a later first-hand claim/dispatch/agent write supersedes it — the assignment record (candidates/method/reasons) persists either way; (c) `docs/infra/managent/spec.md` still says 'Eighteen commands' and does not list `assign` (nor several earlier verbs) — pre-existing drift, not fixed here (spec.md is not in this row's deliverables).
